basis: May 6, 2025 is the earliest qualifying communication I could verify. Celsius reported consolidated GAAP revenue of $329,276,000 for Q1 2025 against $355,708,000 for Q1 2024, a 7.43% decline. The 95% cutoff was $337,922,600. The onset date remains unverified because Celsius also spoke publicly at the March 18 Roth conference, and I could not verify the full remarks.

coverage.detail: November 6, 2024, preceding earnings cycle. The Q3 release attributed the sales decline to inventory reductions by Celsius’s largest distributor. It gave no consolidated revenue ceiling for Q1 2025.

On the Q3 call, the CFO discussed scanner growth and a possible $15 million adjustment in response to a question specifically about Q4 2024 North America sales. Neither the period nor the revenue perimeter matches.

February 7. The 8-K identifies the two image-based exhibits as a derivative-action settlement notice and the underlying December 2 settlement agreement. The disclosed $987,500 was for plaintiffs’ fees and expenses.

February 20, immediately preceding earnings release. Celsius reported Q4 and full-year 2024 results and announced the Alani Nu agreement. The release gave no numeric Q1 2025 consolidated revenue outlook.

February 20 call. The CEO described weak early Q1 scanner trends, promotional timing and a difficult comparison with the prior-year Essentials launch. The CFO discussed distributor incentives in Q1 and Q2. Neither quantified a ceiling for consolidated Q1 revenue.
February 20 acquisition presentation. The approximately $2 billion combined sales figure used 2024 sales on a pro forma basis.
February 21 CAGNY presentation. The deck used 2024 actual sales to illustrate combined scale and discussed future synergies. It supplied no consolidated Q1 2025 revenue range.
March 11 Regulation FD disclosure, listed under a March 12 filing date. Celsius announced expiration of the Alani Nu antitrust waiting period. It supplied no sales update.
Celsius publicly announced live fireside chats at UBS on March 12 and Roth on March 18. The notice confirms that investors could hear management at both events.

March 12 UBS remarks, available in a third-party transcript. The CFO described pressure on the first-quarter comparison from later launches and promotions, without quantifying a consolidated revenue decline.

March 18 Roth coverage gap. The dated transcript preview confirms the session began, but only the introduction was readable. I could not retrieve the webcast replay to check the substantive remarks for quarter-specific guidance.
April 1. Celsius announced completion of the Alani Nu acquisition one day after the quarter ended. Alani Nu therefore contributed no revenue to Celsius’s reported March quarter.
May 1. Celsius announced a May 6 premarket results release and an 8 a.m. ET call. The scheduling notice contained no preliminary revenue figure.
May 6 actuals. The unaudited consolidated statements of operations show revenue of 329,276 and 355,708, in thousands of dollars, for the three months ended March 31, 2025 and 2024, respectively.

publication_date_evidence: The earnings release itself is datelined May 6, 2025 and says Celsius reported first-quarter results that day. This establishes the publication date of the verified actual, while the March 18 coverage gap prevents certifying it as the earliest qualifying disclosure.
